name: codeforge
description: CodeForge — Monaco code editor as web app + Android APK (Capacitor)

scripts.android: npm run setup && npm run verify && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('android')){require('child_process').execSync('npx cap add android',{stdio:'inherit'})}" && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android.js prepare
scripts.sync: npm run setup && npm run verify && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android.js prepare
scripts.build:debug: npm run android && node scripts/android.js debug-flags && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run android && node scripts/android.js signing && node scripts/android.js guard-release && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
